title: Meals Not Prepared During Leave: Dietary Credit on the Hospital Stay Charge
content:
**Dietary credit — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations, hospital stay charge.** Meals are not prepared for a resident on leave, so the hospital stay daily charge carries a dietary credit keyed to the bed held as the reservation records it and to the leave's length from the departure date through the hospital stay entry's last day, both days counted.

| Leave length | Bed held, as the reservation records its tier | Dietary credit per day, USD |
|---|---|---|
| 4 days or more | a secure memory care tier (Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room or Private Secure Memory Care Room) | 16.80 (memory-unit dietary credit) |
| 4 days or more | any other tier | 14.10 (standard dietary credit) |
| fewer than 4 days | any tier | none |

**Counting the length (hypothetical dates).** A departure on the 5th and an entry ending on the 8th give a leave of 4 days (5th, 6th, 7th and 8th): the credit applies. A departure on the 6th with the same last day gives 3 days: no credit.
